title: Session URL fields are String instead of url::Url
description: Session.api_url, upload_url, download_url, and event_source_url are all typed as String. validate_session_urls() in client.rs does a string-split scheme check instead of calling url::Url::parse(). The URL templates (upload_url, download_url, event_source_url) contain RFC 6570 placeholders like {accountId} and cannot be parsed as url::Url directly — so String is correct for those three. However api_url has no placeholders and could be url::Url, which would eliminate the validate_session_urls scheme-split heuristic for that field. A minimal improvement: parse api_url with url::Url at fetch_session time and store it typed. The RFC 6570 template fields must remain String.
